title: Brownfield adoption disposition manifest
description: ADOPT-03 complete destination/disposition manifest for a brownfield target: exactly one of create/preserve/conflict/marker-merge/derived-regenerate/human-ratification-required assigned to every harness destination (D-03/D-04 total rule chain), plus a separate excluded[] array recording GSD-owned lanes by reason so "excluded" is distinguishable from "missed". Self-contained Draft 2020-12 — no cross-file $ref (D-11).

target_ref.description: Ties this manifest to the same scan as the inventory's target_ref (same shape: a git ref, or the literal "unknown").

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path pointing INTO an already-hashed inventory includedEntry.

dispositionEnum.description: Exactly these 6 values (D-03/D-04's total rule chain), no more, no fewer.

destination.description: A repo-relative POSIX path in the TARGET tree.

reason.description: Optional: which rule in the chain fired, e.g. constitution-plane / marker-capable:AGENTS.md / hash-equal / hash-differ / no-existing-target.

evidence.description: Optional; may be empty for path-only rules that never read content.

reason.description: E.g. "gsd-owned" — GSD-owned lanes are recorded here as EXCLUDED, never as a dispositions[] entry, so a reviewer can tell "excluded" apart from "missed".
